caption: A straight stick is lowered into a clear pond, and the underwater part appears to angle away from the part above the surface.

sa.check: A stick is lowered into a pond.
The underwater part appears to angle away from the part above the surface.
The stick is straight out of the water.

pc.expect: The apparent bend is at the surface and its size changes with the stick's angle.
pc.fail: The bend is above or below the surface; or it stays the same at every angle; or the stick looks straight in the water.

pc.expect: The stick is straight and rigid; the bend is an appearance that is absent out of the water.
pc.fail: The stick is physically bent when out; or the bend stays at a fixed point on the stick as it is raised; or the stick flexes.

pc.expect: The pond surface is level and the water clear.
pc.fail: The surface tilts and holds; or the water goes opaque; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The stick moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It floats up; or sinks away; or jumps.
It duplicates; or vanishes below the surface; or passes through the bed.

pc.expect: The stick and the pond stay the same.
pc.fail: The stick changes colour underwater; or the pond changes; or the bank rearranges.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
